messages:
Maya L.: Heads-up: we'll test a new handoff behavior that waits briefly for enrichment before assigning. Starting canary at 20% in 15m. Sharing run parameters here.
Owen T.: Clarify: waiting window length? We need to balance speed vs bad-owner churn.
Rae K.: Proposal: wait up to 40s for enrichment complete flag. If it fails, route to Overflow RR and mark lead.fallback=ENRICH_TIMEOUT.
Devon S.: Can we set a soft-alert for leads waiting >25s so SDRs can triage if needed? Also suggest tagging source=canary in HS for easy filtering.
Maya L.: Good call. Add source=canary and fallback_notified=false by default, set true on overflow.
Owen T.: HubSpot workflow snippet (for docs):
```
Trigger: Contact created
If: context.source == "web" OR "api"
Action: delay 30s
Branch: if property(enriched)==true -> set owner via smart-assign
Else -> create task "Overflow assign" + set property(fallback_reason)=ENRICH_TIMEOUT + assign to queue Overflow RR
```
Rae K.: Salesforce mapping note: keep lead.OriginalOwnerId blank if fallback so attribution stays to queue. We'll add a custom field fallback_flag.
Devon S.: Observability plan: dashboard with assign_latency_p50/p95, enrichment_latency, and fallback_rate. Also add alert: fallback_rate > 0.10 for 10m -> page #marketing oncall.
HubSpot Bot: Workflow "Canary Enrich Handoff" created by Owen T. (ID: 17288)
SDR Oncall: SDRs notified. We'll pause drip sequences for canary leads until final owner confirmed.
Maya L.: Runbook checklist before go: confirm webhook secrets, mute expected-alerts, notify SDR rotation, create quick rollback in HS.
Owen T.: I'll push the feature flag and monitor metrics. Planning 20m observation window before decision.
Rae K.: FYI, if enrichment pipeline has backlog we'll shorten wait to 15s automatically via autoscaler signal.
Devon S.: Posting links to dashboards and playbook in #marketing shortly.
Maya L.: Thanks team. If anyone sees assign regressions DM me. We'll reconvene after the 20m window for a 10m post-mortem. :thumbsup:
